columns.name: awards_per_state_value
columns.description: awards per state value. Completions per 100 FTE (full-time equivalency) undergraduate students, state and sector average
columns.value_description:
commonsense evidence:
 if his institute's completion (or graduation) rate exceeds the average for the state and sector in which it belongs:
awards_per_value > awards_per_state_value
 if his institute's completion (or graduation) rate falls below the average for the state and sector in which it belongs:
awards_per_value < awards_per_state_value

columns.name: awards_per_natl_value
columns.description: awards per national value. Completions per 100 FTE (full-time equivalency) undergraduate students, national sector average
columns.value_description:
commonsense evidence:
 if his institute's completion (or graduation) rate exceeds the average for the nationalin which it belongs:
awards_per_value > awards_per_natl_value
 if his institute's completion (or graduation) rate falls below the average for the state and industry in which it belongs:
awards_per_value < awards_per_natl_value
